appalachians-tail-of-the-dragon-and-cher.title: Appalachians · US 129 Deals Gap and Cherohala
appalachians-tail-of-the-dragon-and-cher.slogan: A 202 km loop out of Deals Gap
appalachians-tail-of-the-dragon-and-cher.story: Corners, discipline and zero interest in showing off. Out of Robbinsville and back again: 202 km, roughly 3 h 53 in the saddle. The stops in between: Cherohala Skyway and Tellico Plains. US 129 Deals Gap is the high point. The passes are the reason to go.

places-component-around-hugh-nelson-rang.story: From Atherton it runs 280 km to Atherton; allow about 4 h 50 of riding. It goes by way of Component around Russell River, Component around Kurrimine Beach and back through Component around Russell River. The highest point is about 900 m. The line favours views over speed.

legend-hai-van-pass.story: A coastal mountain pass from Da Nang, Vietnam to Hue, Vietnam, via Hai Van summit. Key character: sea views; jungle; historic pass. Surface: paved.
